title: C-3PO
franchise: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
description: Built by Anakin Skywalker, C-3PO was a Droid programmed for etiquette and protocol, though he was also well-versed in other forms of labor ranging from moisture vaporators to binary load-lifters. Eventually, he became a tool of the Rebel Alliance and helped Princess Leia Organa in many capacities. He found himself back on Tatooine as part of a plot to rescue Han Solo from the clutches of Jabba the Hutt and was given to the gangster as a gift. Jabba then installed the Droid as his new interpreter.
